subject: Using knitr with Rstudio in linuxmint 15 Xfce, knitr with engine='python/dot' not work....

messages.author: ae61b6b8911d6ad3
messages.subject: Using knitr with Rstudio in linuxmint 15 Xfce, knitr with engine='python/dot' not work....
parts:
I googled for 3 days but not got any Q/A related. It looks everyone except me got this error/bug/whatever.

The syndrome:

1. Open a new Rnw file in RStudio and renamed it to temp.Rnw
2. temp.Rnw:

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

<<engine='python',eval=FALSE>>=
print 'Holy world!'
@

\end{document}

3. Then i pressed the 'Compile PDF' icon, then the a new tab besides 'Console' opened named 'Compile PDF', all seems ok here.

It echoes:

> grDevices::pdf.options(useDingbats = FALSE); require(knitr); opts_knit$set(concordance = TRUE); knit('temp.Rnw')
载入需要的程辑包：knitr


processing file: temp.Rnw
  |......................                                           |  33%
  ordinary text without R code

  |...........................................                      |  67%
label: unnamed-chunk-1 (with options) 
List of 2
 $ engine: chr "python"
 $ eval  : logi FALSE

running: 'python'  -c "print 'Holy world!'"


4. The problem is it stoped without any hints. All i can do is to click the STOP button on the top right corner of this tab.

5. Any help will be great!!! Can somebody tell me how to generate a bug report for this?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Using knitr with Rstudio in linuxmint 15 Xfce, knitr with engine='python/dot' not work....
parts:
Okay, this weird problem was due to Linux Mint's
/usr/local/bin/highlight, which expects input from stdin; if there is
no input from stdin, it hangs and waits for input.

I have fixed the problem in highr v0.2.6: https://github.com/yihui/highr

Regards,
Yihui
